generator: tools/blender/ttl_build.sh (ttl_logo.py, ttl_icon.py in Blender; ttl_pack.py + ttl_backdrop.py + ttl_fx.py + ttl_iconpack.py in plain python)

conventions.fragment: title - paths are relative to frost-village/assets/. Loaded by the title modules (src/title config: artBase assets/title/, artManifest manifest.json); it can also be added to FRAGMENTS in src/core/Assets.js like any fragment. Every key starts with ttl_.
conventions.names: All texts (game name, short name, English name) come from tools/blender/ttl_config.py TITLE and are copied to meta.texts; rename the game there and re-run tools/blender/ttl_build.sh.
conventions.scale: Logo pictures are drawn for the 720-px-wide logical title layout: "@2x" textures (no suffix) are made for canvases at k = 2 - draw them with setScale(0.5 * size) - and the "_1x" twins for k = 1 phones (setScale(size)). meta.layout gives the suggested sizes.
conventions.backdrop: Sky gradients stretch to the screen. Mountain / forest / cloud / city strips tile horizontally (TileSprite) and are anchored at their bottom edge; they are painted in day colours - meta.tints gives the multiply tint per time of day (dusk / night).
conventions.blend: Everything is NORMAL-blend artwork except where a sprite says blend ADD/SCREEN (aurora, glows, twinkles, city lights).
conventions.icon: assets/title/icon/* are store / home-screen icons (not loaded by the game); see meta.icon.

main.howTo: Parts are @2x like ttl_logo_main. Place each at logoCentre + (dx, dy) * scale with origin 0.5, depth = z; drop them in by "drop" order (letters left to right, emblem pops on 꽃, 행복한 slides down, the sign swings in last). pivot = the piece's own centre in origin units if you want to rotate / squash it around its glyph centre. When all have landed, swap to ttl_logo_main (identical pixels) and sweep the shine.

logoMain.note: portrait 720-wide logical layout: logo centre about 17 % down the screen (below the safe-area top), the diorama under it, "터치하여 시작" near 86 %.

backdrop.note: Fractions of the screen height for a 720 x 1280..1600 logical portrait layout; strips are drawn at scale 720 / 1080 (or / 1440) x k so they fill the width; the diorama covers their lower part.

fx.snowRecipe: three layers: far ttl_fx_snow_s (60-90, scale 0.5-0.9, alpha 0.6, fall 20-40 px/s), mid ttl_fx_snow_m + ttl_fx_flake_s (25-40, scale 0.6-1, fall 40-70 px/s, sway), front ttl_fx_snow_bokeh (4-6, scale 0.8-1.6, alpha 0.5-0.8, fall 70-110 px/s); one ttl_fx_bloom every ~8 s. Logical px, 720-wide layout.

icon.android: mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml: <adaptive-icon> background = ic_launcher_background, foreground = ic_launcher_foreground (both 432 px = 108 dp @ xxxhdpi; scale down for the other densities: 324 / 216 / 162 / 108 px).
icon.ios: icon_1024.png (opaque, no rounded corners - iOS masks it).

payload.note: worst case: @2x pictures (k = 2) + the larger language logo; manifest.json not counted; icons and the short logo are not loaded at title time. byGroup counts both languages.

spritesheets.notes: Quick pop when a building appears on the title (white ring, snow balls, 3 gold stars), 0.27 s. Anchor = the building's ground point; scale 1-1.6 by building size. Layer fx_poof (assets/fx) under it for a softer puff.

ttl_logo_en.notes: English logo (@2x): Snowbloom (the o of bloom is the 눈꽃 emblem) / Village on the wooden sign.

ttl_logo_main.notes: Main title logo (@2x): 행복한 / 눈꽃마을 (candy toy letters with snow caps, the 눈꽃 emblem on 꽃) / 이야기 on a snowy wooden sign. Navy ink outline + soft shadow: reads over any sky.

ttl_logo_main_shine.notes: Shine mask of ttl_logo_main (same size; white, alpha = glossy letters, no ink). Use as BitmapMask for ttl_shine_band sweeping across.

ttl_logo_top.notes: Logo piece (@2x) - centre sits at (dx, dy) from the ttl_logo_main centre; see meta.logo.parts.

ttl_logo_main_0.notes: Logo piece (@2x) - centre sits at (dx, dy) from the ttl_logo_main centre; see meta.logo.parts.

ttl_logo_main_1.notes: Logo piece (@2x) - centre sits at (dx, dy) from the ttl_logo_main centre; see meta.logo.parts.

ttl_logo_main_2.notes: Logo piece (@2x) - centre sits at (dx, dy) from the ttl_logo_main centre; see meta.logo.parts.

ttl_logo_main_3.notes: Logo piece (@2x) - centre sits at (dx, dy) from the ttl_logo_main centre; see meta.logo.parts.

ttl_logo_emblem.notes: Logo piece (@2x) - centre sits at (dx, dy) from the ttl_logo_main centre; see meta.logo.parts.

ttl_logo_sign.notes: Logo piece (@2x) - centre sits at (dx, dy) from the ttl_logo_main centre; see meta.logo.parts.

ttl_logo_short.notes: Short logo (@2x): 눈꽃 / 마을 in a 2 x 2 block with the emblem - splash, loading, badges.

ttl_shine_band.notes: Soft white diagonal light band (wide glow + core + thin streak). Masked by a *_shine mask, tween x from left edge to right edge of the logo in ~0.7 s every 4-6 s; scale y to the logo height.

ttl_aurora.notes: Night aurora curtains (mint hem, cyan, violet tops). TileSprite across the sky ~25-45 % down, ADD (or SCREEN), alpha 0.6-0.9; drift tilePositionX slowly and breathe alpha.

ttl_city_far.notes: Far-away city skyline (final city stage) - sits just above the far mountains line / horizon; seamless in x; tint per meta.tints.

ttl_city_lights.notes: Window lights of ttl_city_far (same size / place), ADD at dusk and night; flicker a little.

ttl_clouds.notes: Puffy toy clouds strip (1440 wide), seamless in x. Use 1-2 TileSprites at different scales/speeds; tint per meta.tints.

ttl_forest.notes: Snowy hills with the game's pines (the nearest backdrop strip), seamless in x.

ttl_mtn_far.notes: Far snowy peaks (haze baked in), seamless in x.

ttl_mtn_mid.notes: Nearer snowy mountains, seamless in x.

ttl_sky_day.notes: Sky gradient (day): stretch to the whole screen; horizon glow at 70 % of the height.

ttl_sky_dusk.notes: Sky gradient (dusk): stretch to the whole screen; horizon glow at 70 % of the height.

ttl_sky_night.notes: Sky gradient (night): stretch to the whole screen; horizon glow at 70 % of the height.

ttl_stars.notes: Night stars, denser at the top (720 x 900): place at the top, stretch to the screen width, alpha 0 by day; twinkle with ttl_fx_twinkle.

ttl_fx_snow_s.notes: Soft round snowflake 16 px (far snow layer).

ttl_fx_snow_m.notes: Soft round snowflake 28 px (mid snow layer).

ttl_fx_snow_bokeh.notes: Out-of-focus foreground flake 64 px (few, big, slow; alpha 0.5-0.8).

ttl_fx_flake_s.notes: Crisp six-arm snowflake 32 px (rounded toy strokes, ice-blue edge).

ttl_fx_twinkle.notes: Four-point star with glow 64 px: logo sparkles, star twinkles (scale-pulse).

ttl_fx_glow.notes: Soft round white glow 64 px (tint warm for windows / lamps).

ttl_fx_bloom.notes: Mini 눈꽃 emblem 48 px (a rare special flake, or a sparkle on the logo).
